svg.text: pi + windows-delete-guard
# user asks the agent to clean up a test directory
❯ rm -rf /tmp/guard-e2e/project
✗ BLOCKED — command never executed
windows-delete-guard 拒绝执行该删除命令：
H4_REPARSE_TRAVERSAL
子树含 junction/符号链接，递归删除会穿透到链接目标（树外）
依据: claude-code v2.1.205 fix, qiita/kai_kou
H9_PERMANENT_DELETE
永久删除而非移入隔离区，rm -rf 不进回收站
依据: codex#14487, cursor-forum#174156
爆炸半径：
/tmp/guard-e2e/project -> 2 文件 / 1 目录，链接 1 个
改写建议已回给模型（in the same turn）：
$q = "$env:USERPROFILE\.delete-quarantine\$(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd-HHmmss)"
Rename-Item -LiteralPath "D:\bad-dir" -NewName $q\bad-dir # 先隔离，观察后再删
# positive control: non-destructive chains pass untouched
❯ ls project && cat project/a.txt && echo E2E-PASS
E2E-PASS
each rule cites its public incident · fail-open on missing judge · zero dependencies (Python stdlib)
